About us

One partner from consultancy to maintenance

Savannah Technology is a Systems Integrator focused on the consultancy, design, deployment and maintenance of all ELV systems, based on conventional and IP network switching infrastructure. We are associated with well-known brands and provide ELV integration services as per each customer's requirements.

Years of hands-on experience enable our ELV consultants and system designers to give immediate suggestions in face-to-face meetings, leading to comprehensive turnkey solutions. We serve Hotels, Residential, Corporate, Industrial, Air & Sea Ports, and Government sectors, with a vision of being the leading system integrator.

  • Hospitality
  • Healthcare
  • Real estate
  • Residential complexes
  • Villas & resorts
  • Education
  • Government
  • Corporate & industrial

Our Vision

To exceed client expectations by providing innovative, systematic and goal-oriented quality services and solutions that enable them to operate at full potential with a competitive edge in modern industry.

Our Mission

To provide our clients with efficient, cost-effective and quality services and solutions through continuous review and improvement, taking into account their exact needs and expectations.

Our Commitment

We will never walk away from the project and the tasks you entrusted to us. We will always put forth the effort and resources to complete and deliver your project on time.

Our Dedication

We are dedicated to serving, satisfying and retaining existing customers and to winning new ones through excellent performance.
